subject: [PATCH 2/3] perf/core: Don't let BPF programs read an uninitialized sample address

2026-11-19.patch_summary: This patch prevents BPF programs from reading uninitialized sample addresses by clearing the address field in the bpf_perf_event_data structure if it hasn't been filled in yet. This is done to prevent potential security vulnerabilities and ensure that BPF programs behave correctly even when running on kernels built with CONFIG_INIT_STACK_ALL_ZERO or INIT_STACK_ALL_PATTERN. The patch affects only events with a BPF program attached, leaving other events unaffected.
